title: Pilot Early, Commit Late: A Real-Options Model of Enterprise AI Adoption under Rapid Technological Progress
abstract: arXiv:2609.15919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence presents firms with an unusual timing problem. The technology frontier is improving rapidly, implementation is partly irreversible, and organization-specific capabilities are accumulated through action. This paper develops a two-period decision model of AI deployment under uncertainty in which a firm chooses among immediate deployment, a limited pilot, and waiting. Deployment earns current operating value but exposes the firm to architectural obsolescence; waiting preserves the option to adopt after the frontier is observed; a pilot sacrifices current operating value to build organization-specific learning without full commitment. The model yields five central timing results and a sixth comparative result on where learning occurs. First, a mean-preserving increase in frontier uncertainty raises the value of waiting and piloting but leaves immediate deployment unchanged when its payoff is affine in the frontier. Se

translated_title: 早期试点，延迟承诺：快速技术进步下企业人工智能采用的实物期权模型
translated_abstract: 人工智能给企业带来了一个不同寻常的时机问题：技术前沿正在快速进步，实施具有部分不可逆性，而组织特有的能力只能通过实际行动来积累。本文构建了一个不确定性下AI部署的两期决策模型，企业可以在立即部署、有限试点和等待这三种策略之间进行选择。立即部署能获得当前的运营价值，但会使企业面临技术架构过时的风险；等待则保留了在观察到技术前沿后再采用的期权价值；试点通过牺牲当前运营价值，在不做出完全承诺的情况下建立组织特有的学习能力。该模型得出了五个核心的时机选择结果，以及一个关于学习发生位置的第六个比较结果。第一，在技术前沿不确定性的均值保持型增加下，等待和试点的价值会上升，但当立即部署的收益是技术前沿的仿射函数时，立即部署的价值保持不变……
tldr: 本文构建实物期权决策模型，揭示在AI技术快速进步背景下，企业最优策略是“早期试点、延迟承诺”——通过有限试点积累组织特有的学习能力，同时保留在观察技术前沿后再完全部署的期权价值，以平衡当前运营收益与架构过时风险。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a real-options model showing that under rapid AI technological progress, the optimal firm strategy is to "pilot early and commit late"—using limited pilots to build organization-specific learning while preserving the option value of full deployment, thereby balancing current operating value against architectural obsolescence risk.
